limitations: splitMsgs is unexported; a separated public Take (remove+return selected message) must be hand-rolled on the exported env.Messages field.

Export a Take helper in rafttest (e.g., TakeMsgs(recipient, typ) returning removed messages plus routing info) so the separated form is public.
